author: New China TV
description: Who would've thought stainless steel, a familiar sight in the kitchen, could rival gold and silver in style? At the 140th Canton Fair, a Guangzhou brand is drawing global buyers with lightweight, color-retaining stainless steel jewelry at affordable prices.
title: Stainless steel jewelry draws global buyers at Canton Fair

author: New China TV
description:
The first batch of exhibits for the 9th China International Import Expo has arrived at the National Exhibition and Convention Center in Shanghai.
Many exhibits will make their global or Asian debut at this year's CIIE.
#CIIE #Shanghai #Trade #Innovation #China
title: First exhibits enter 9th CIIE venue as setup enters final stretch

author: New China TV
description: Public trust in the CPC is built through the Party's concrete actions to improve people's lives, said a Brazilian expert, highlighting the link between these efforts and the CPC's commitment to full and rigorous Party self-governance. #China #CPC #PartyGovernance
title: Decoding Party self-governance: How CPC builds trust through concrete actions

author: New China TV
description:
More than 90 years ago, three Red Army soldiers shared their only quilt with a local family in Shazhou Village, China. Today, that story of kindness lives on as the village turns its heritage into new opportunities - from red tourism to traditional Yao embroidery, helping local residents build better lives.
#China #ChinaStories #RuralRevitalization #CulturalHeritage #YaoEmbroidery
title: From Long March legacy to shared prosperity: Shazhou Village's transformation

author: New China TV
description:
Another mega bridge across the Yangtze River is taking shape in China's Chongqing.
The Huangjuetuo Yangtze River Bridge has completed the closure of its 765-meter main span. With a double-deck design combining an expressway, urban roads, and reserved rail transit, the bridge is set to improve cross-river connectivity and regional integration.
#Chongqing #BridgeConstruction #Infrastructure #Engineering
title: Chongqing's new double-deck bridge joins up

author: New China TV
description: A speech by Chinese President Xi Jinping at a ceremony commemorating the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Long March of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army has been published as a booklet. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi's speech marking 90th anniversary of Long March victory published

author: New China TV
description: A Kenyan youth team has claimed gold at the Global AgriInno Challenge 2026 in Hangzhou, China, as it seeks to connect East African smallholder farmers with climate finance and digital agricultural services. #Kenya #China #AgriTech
title: Kenyan youth tap climate finance to promote sustainable farming

author: New China TV
description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva declared victory in the country's presidential runoff on Sunday night, saying that "this country is nobody's backyard." #BrazilianPresident #LuizInacioLuladaSilva
title: Lula declares victory in Brazil's presidential runoff

author: New China TV
description: Farmers returning to Syria's Afrin are struggling to restore olive groves and rebuild livelihoods disrupted by years of displacement. Rising costs of diesel, fertilizer and other agricultural supplies continue to hamper efforts. #Syria #Afrin #OliveHarvest
title: Returning farmers in Syria's Afrin struggle to restore livelihoods through olive farming

author: New China TV
description:
From high-wire performances and ground acrobatics to dazzling magic shows and comedy, the 16th Wuhan International Acrobatic Art Festival brings together performers from 14 countries to showcase amazing skills and creativity in central China's Wuhan.
#China #Wuhan #Acrobatics
title: Spectacular acrobatics wow audiences in China

author: New China TV
description:
In Chengdu, a dedicated hub for China-Europe business cooperation is bringing companies and experts together to explore what's next.
In the wake of the second meeting of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism, Xinhua correspondent Zheng Bofei visited the 19th China-EU Business and Technology Cooperation Fair recently to ask companies and experts where they see opportunities to work together, ranging from green technology to robotics.
title: Exploring China-Europe cooperation in Chengdu

author: New China TV
description: A Chinese firm has joined rescue efforts as five people remain missing following a building's collapse on Friday in Nairobi, Kenya. The firm provided a crane and an excavator that were used over the weekend to help free two trapped people. #Nairobi #Kenya #BuildingCollapse #rescue
title: Chinese firm helps rescue two in Nairobi building collapse

author: New China TV
description: Tunisian athletes practiced Wushu in north China's Tianjin, in preparation for the traditional martial art's debut at Africa's first-ever Olympic event: the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, which will open later this week. #Wushu #YouthOlympics
title: Tunisian Wushu athletes train for Youth Olympics in China's Tianjin

author: New China TV
description: Former Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda has passed away, local media reported Monday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Former Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda passes away: media

description: The 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) started its fifth plenary session in Beijing on Monday morning. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 20th CPC Central Committee starts fifth plenary session

author: New China TV
description: Former Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in Sunday's snap parliamentary election, as independent projections and leaders of a student-backed movement born out of anti-corruption protests confirmed an outright parliamentary majority that ends the Serbian Progressive Party's (SNS) 14-year grip on power. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Serbia's Vucic concedes election defeat as student-led movement claims victory

author: New China TV
description: From a small makeup brush to a global beauty business! Qingxian County in north China, produces over 500 million makeup brushes a year, bringing Chinese craftsmanship and homegrown brands to beauty lovers worldwide. British blogger Adam explores the people and innovation behind this thriving industry. #BeautyIndustry #MadeInChina
title: British vlogger explores China's makeup brush capital and beauty economy

author: New China TV
description:
What an unforgettable scene to witness!

China successfully launched the Yaogan-50 03 remote sensing satellite aboard a modified Long March-6 carrier rocket on Friday. As the rocket pierced the sky, farmers gathered corn below, all in one breathtaking frame.

#ChinaSpace #LongMarch6 #harvest #satellite
title: Autumn harvest meets rocket launch in one frame

title: Xinhua News | Lula re-elected Brazilian president in runoff
